We use the implementation of PET available from https://github.com/timoschick/pet.

We ran the PET experiments on CPU with up to 20 threads (Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2630 v4). The time used per experiment depends on the particular setting (mainly number of patterns) and the model size. For example, training the model for German noun number with $n = 100$ training sentences on three patterns took approximately 2 hours for mbert and 6.5 hours for xlmr-large.
